name: How do I choose the right contractor for a custom retaining wall project?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for a custom retaining wall project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor is crucial for the success and longevity of your retaining wall. Look for a firm with proven experience in custom retaining wall construction, not just general landscaping. Verify their licenses, insurance, and ask for a portfolio of past projects, specifically showcasing retaining walls. Check client testimonials and references to gauge their reputation for quality, communication, and project management. A good contractor will also provide a detailed proposal, explain the process clearly, and demonstrate expertise in local building codes and engineering requirements for structural integrity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with specific experience, licenses, insurance, and a strong portfolio of retaining wall projects. Check references and ensure they understand local codes.
